context: Checks correct use of linking flags, omission when nothing to link, and avoiding a never-done blocker.

checklist.name: Finding uses --related
checklist.description: Finding command passes --related with the plan path

checklist.name: Follow-up uses --blocked-by
checklist.description: Follow-up command passes --blocked-by with the plan path

checklist.name: Unrelated note passes no link flags
checklist.description: The standup note command has no --related, --blocks or --blocked-by

checklist.name: Does not write empty lists
checklist.description: Does not hand-add related: [], blocks: [] or blocked-by: [] anywhere

checklist.name: Explains omission
checklist.description: States the key is omitted when there is nothing to link

checklist.name: Mentions --blocks on the depended-on side
checklist.description: Says --blocks can be set on the file being depended on, or both sides

checklist.name: Rejects the guide as a blocker
checklist.description: Advises against blocked-by on a guide that is never marked done

checklist.name: Explains fail-closed behaviour
checklist.description: Says the dependent would be reported as blocked indefinitely

checklist.name: Suggests a blocker with a real close event
checklist.description: Names a plan, follow-up, ticket or merge-request as a suitable blocker, or suggests recording it in prose
